scope: IE-08/12 diagnostic refinement: same64-wide17gate MLP, matched weight warm-starts, improved objective versus budget control, and tabulated deployment of frozen neural predictions.
decision: Separate kinetic error attribution, accuracy repair and inference representation cost without claiming a tabulated neural function is a new neural architecture.
warm_start: For eachseed use its own IE-P4 internal_w64 frozen checkpoint, never the best fresh seed. Copy weights to two matched branches; Adam moments reset identically because prior optimizer state was not saved. New paired fit/development streams. No from-scratch claim; changes versus P4 conflate new data, optimizer reset and additional budget.
base_loss: P4 normalized transition MSE + u MSE + .01 log(z/zscale+1e-8) MSE, identical both branches.
balanced_loss: Add .01 MSE(raw_u_logits-logit(clamp(target_u,1e-6,1-1e-6))), MSE of400step constant-voltage endpoints from x0=0 and1, and .1 max_over_gate(mean_over_batch(normalized_transition_error_squared)). No extra online inputs.
selection: Same criterion for both branches: maximum of development transition_RMSE/.001, transition_max/.01 and constant-voltage400step_endpoint_max/.03; minimum across registered checkpoints independently perseed. Freeze hash before fresh outcomes. This differs prospectively from P4 selection.
deployment: Freeze six selected MLPs, then sample only their u,z outputs at uniform1mV and.25mV knots; linear interpolation, no analytic coefficient substitution. Both tables evaluated even if conversion fails its error budget. This is numerical compilation to LUTs, not learned sparse knots or a novel neural layer. Report tablebytes versus parameterbytes; latency includes actual deployed map, compilation excluded.
conversion_probe: 65537-point deterministic dense voltage grid; compare worst single-step endpoint difference at x0=0/1 against original frozenMLP. Finite-grid diagnostic bound, not continuous-domain proof. Never selects between deployment grids on fresh.
attribution: On already-opened Task35 only, for each frozen64seed swap exact u_all, z_all or both coefficients of calcium,sodium,potassium,Ih/Im groups.18oracle interventions, diagnosis only; no training selection or cost eligibility. Report fullV/Ca metrics and worsening as well as improvements. Group effects need not add.
input_contract: CurrentV and explicit18gate state;17V-dependent gates approximated. SK,calcium law, exact vectorized readout,synapses and membrane solver unchanged; Ca->SK order fixed, dt.1ms, voltage domain[-100,60]mV. No hidden-state compression.
paths: 24 new paths,6families x4 asP4, seed81802; only generated/evaluated after freeze. Constant,steps,sinusoid,chirp,pulse-recovery,randomwalk. HistoricalTask35 remains opened diagnostic, no new native confirmation.

hypotheses.H_accuracy: Balanced objective improves worst-case and recursive errors over identically warm-started standard internal refit at matched extra budget.
hypotheses.H_representation: Numerical compilation of the same frozen neural function reduces latency without exceeding conversion budget and preserves registered quality; separate accuracy versus execution.
hypotheses.H_localization: Exact coefficient swaps on frozen models identify whether u,z and channel groups contribute differently to V versusCa errors; a reducing swap is conditional evidence, not unique mechanism proof.

validation: Verify parentSHA,warm-start equivalence, batched versus separate clippedAdam, teacher-coefficient intervention controls, LUT knot/interpolation invariance, compiler eager/graph preflights. Technical failure is not scientific no-go. SameGPU no training/timing contention; no eager fallback for failed compile.
exclusions: No automatic promotion or new native/morphology confirmation. Fixed-input resident timing excludes host RNG,events,transfers. Outside voltage domain not covered; tables hold boundary coefficients, denseMLP sees actualV. Tabulation cannot repair model bias by itself and its compiler error is measured separately. More training does not remove denseMLP inference cost. No OpenEvolve or custom kernels.
